factual_claims.claim: During the first three months of 2026, AB Pieno Žvaigždės recorded total revenue of 52,064 thousand euros, showing a slight decrease compared to 52,324 thousand euros reported in the corresponding period of 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of comprehensive income shows Revenue for 2026 01 01 - 2026 03 31 as 52,064 thousand EUR and for 2025 03 31 as 52,324 thousand EUR.

factual_claims.claim: Despite the minor drop in sales, the company achieved a substantial improvement in profitability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of comprehensive income shows significant increase in Gross profit (13,986 vs 9,794), Operating profit before finance costs (3,366 vs 535), and Net profit (3,068 vs 227) from Q1 2025 to Q1 2026.

factual_claims.claim: Cost of sales decreased significantly to 38,078 thousand euros from 42,530 thousand euros in the previous year, which drove a sharp rise in gross profit to 13,986 thousand euros compared to 9,794 thousand euros in the first quarter of 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of comprehensive income shows Cost of sales as (38,078) for 2026 and (42,530) for 2025; Gross profit as 13,986 for 2026 and 9,794 for 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Other operating income, net, stood at 363 thousand euros, up from 28 thousand euros, while sales and administrative expenses increased to 10,983 thousand euros from 9,287 thousand euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of comprehensive income shows Other operating income, net as 363 for 2026 and 28 for 2025; Sales and administrative expenses as (10,983) for 2026 and (9,287) for 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Consequently, the operating profit before finance costs surged to 3,366 thousand euros, compared to 535 thousand euros during the same period in 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of comprehensive income shows Operating profit before finance costs as 3,366 for 2026 and 535 for 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization reached 4,730 thousand euros, compared to 2,001 thousand euros previously.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Main indicators of the Company’s performance table shows EBITDA as 4,730 thousand EUR for 2026 and 2,001 thousand EUR for 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Net financial expenses remained relatively stable at 298 thousand euros compared to 308 thousand euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of comprehensive income shows Finance income/expenses, net as (298) for 2026 and (308) for 2025.

factual_claims.claim: As a result, the company reported a net profit of 3,068 thousand euros for the three months ended March 31, 2026, marking a dramatic increase from the net profit of 227 thousand euros recorded in the first three months of 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of comprehensive income shows Net profit as 3,068 for 2026 and 227 for 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Net profit per share correspondingly rose to 0.07 euros from 0.01 euros, and the book value per share at the end of the period was 0.91 euros compared to 0.89 euros at the end of March 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Main indicators table shows Earnings per share (EUR) as 0,07 for 2026 and 0,01 for 2025; Book value per share (EUR) as 0,91 for 2026 and 0,89 for 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Regarding the financial position, total assets increased to 85,305 thousand euros as of March 31, 2026, from 83,475 thousand euros at the end of December 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of financial position shows Total assets as 85,305 thousand EUR for 2026 03 31 and 83,475 thousand EUR for 2025 12 31.

factual_claims.claim: Total equity grew to 41,164 thousand euros from 38,238 thousand euros, driven by an increase in retained earnings to 18,614 thousand euros from 15,688 thousand euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of financial position shows Total equity as 41,164 thousand EUR for 2026 03 31 and 38,238 thousand EUR for 2025 12 31; Retained earnings as 18,614 thousand EUR for 2026 03 31 and 15,688 thousand EUR for 2025 12 31.

factual_claims.claim: Total liabilities decreased to 44,141 thousand euros from 45,237 thousand euros over the same timeframe.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of financial position shows Total liabilities as 44,141 thousand EUR for 2026 03 31 and 45,237 thousand EUR for 2025 12 31.

factual_claims.claim: Cash flows also showed a positive development, with net cash flow from operating activities turning positive at 1,625 thousand euros compared to a negative 183 thousand euros in the first quarter of 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of cash flows shows Net cash flow from operating activities as 1,625 thousand EUR for 2026 03 31 and (183) thousand EUR for 2025 03 31.
